description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Hiring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="New Hire Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Hiring">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NeedIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IntegrateTeam</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Integrated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ScreenResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PhoneInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCandidates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_InterviewFormatSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InPersonInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VirtualInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_InterviewFormatJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCandidate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExtendOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_NegotiationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateSalary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_NegotiationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Onboarding</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for new hire identified" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="Post job description on job boards" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PhoneInterview" name="Conduct initial phone interview" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates for interview" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" name="Candidate preference: in-person or virtual" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" name="Interview completed" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCandidate" name="Choose candidate" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_NegotiationSplit" name="Salary negotiation needed?" default="Flow_NoNegotiation" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_NegotiationJoin" name="Salary terms settled" />

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance" />

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Onboarding" name="Onboard new hire">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Onboarding_Start" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Orientation" name="Conduct orientation" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Training" name="Provide training" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Onboarding_End" name="Onboarding completed" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnbStart" sourceRef="Onboarding_Start" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnbPaperwork" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_Orientation" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnbOrientation" sourceRef="Task_Orientation" targetRef="Task_Training" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnbTraining" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="Onboarding_End" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IntegrateTeam" name="Confirm new hire fully integrated into team" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterview" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewFormat == 'inPerson'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewFormat == 'virtual'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="GW_NegotiationSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="GW_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${negotiationRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoNegotiation" sourceRef="GW_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="GW_NegotiationJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="GW_NegotiationJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="GW_NegotiationJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance" targetRef="SubProcess_Onboarding" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="SubProcess_Onboarding" targetRef="Task_IntegrateTeam" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_IntegrateTeam" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
